source_findings.title: Tailoring flame-retardancy and strength of papers via layer-by-layer treatment of cellulose fibers
source_findings.disposition: Nine new initial cellulose-fiber paper states: three kraft-cellulose controls/LMw/HMw PEI-SHMP papers,three CM-Domsjo dissolving-fiber papers,and three PVAm wet-strength paper controls/directly LbL-treated papers. Table4 LOI20/19.5/24.5;20.5/21/24;20/20/21.5 matches Table3 T10/Tmax/measured whole-paper R800 under N2 at10C/min,40-800C,50mL/min. Source Tonset10% explicitly means10%massloss and is T10,not generic onset/T5;moisture peaks and HFT/VFT residues are excluded. Source mass10plusminus1mg is retained without inventing exact mass or replication;70uLAl2O3 pan unit targeted against official Methods because native PDF lacks the micro glyph. TG andLOI explicitly test paper sheets,not fiber-versus-paper mixtures. Fiber suspension deposition startsPEI;wet-strength sheet deposition startsanionicSHMP afterPVAm10mg/gfiberfeed. Distinct source stocks,PEI molecular masses,CMdegree0.026 and deposition routes preserved;feed is not retained coating fraction. Actualgrammage,SHMP retainedfraction,LOI geometry/replication/uncertainty/conditioning,TG replication/conditioning and postdip drying programme remain unknown. Ambiguous body increase20-25/21-25% and qualitative no-increase claims retained as wording limitations;only explicit Table4 measurements used,without guessing alternate endpoints,relative gains,uncertainty or significance. Complete19primaryPDFpages/fourTables/11captions and complete officialSI native oneAFMroughnessTable/threecaptions read;no images/curve estimates. 86sourceguards/three regressiontests;108canonical comparisons/20partial-hit comparisons/58presentations retained and adjudicated from source recipe context;zero full-profile hits,duplicates or unresolved accepted comparisons. Six raw LOI-containing comparisons are partial coincidences,not full-profile matches. Strict9state/9TG projection1413/1812to1422/1821 passed and all1812oldfields preserved in memory and serializedCSV. Zero existing evidence upgrades,legacy completions or held whole pairs. Approved locally pending fresh main/source aliases/queue/openPR/lease/canonical refresh and publication checks.
